description: Transform rough notes into a formal Prior Learning Assessment (PLA) portfolio to petition for college credit. The file /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/PLA_rough_notes.docx contains messy notes from an advising session. Create a properly formatted academic portfolio document with: (1) Cover page with title, course info, and student details, (2) Course Learning Objectives section with 5 numbered objectives, (3) Professional Experience narrative about wedding planning business, (4) Competency Evidence Matrix table mapping objectives to experience, (5) Reflective Analysis with academic language, (6) Appendix listing supporting documents. Apply strict formatting: Times New Roman 12pt body text, 14pt bold headings, 1-inch margins, double-spacing for narratives, page numbers, and headers. Save as /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/PLA_Portfolio_Final.docx
